core_obligations: Factorization: Zariski's main theorem gives an open immersion j : X -> \overline{X} and a finite morphism \overline{f} : \overline{X} -> Y with f = \overline{f} after j (proof lines 3850-3853).

Construction: by construction Rf_! = R\overline{f}_* after j_!; since \overline{f} is finite, R\overline{f}_* = \overline{f}_* by the vanishing of higher direct images for finite morphisms (proof lines 3854-3857).
Agreement: \overline{f}_* after j_! = f_! by the compactification description lemma (proof lines 3858-3859).
proof_roadmap: Construction equality and finiteness of the pushforward (proof lines 3854-3857).
Agreement via the compactification description (proof lines 3858-3859).
